ios.desc:
Real life social, naturally.

Meet friends in real life, organically.
Rill is for the spontaneous, the curious, the “what are you up to today?” moments. Whether it’s climbing, hiking, pickle ball, or sipping coffee, Rill makes it easy to throw out an invite, join something casual, and connect in a way that feels natural.

No over-planning. No pressure.
Just light, last-minute plans we call Meshes.
Create one. Join one. See what’s happening nearby.


• Discover what's happening around you, in real time
• Create a Mesh around what you love; yoga, dirt biking, golfing, whatever
• Meet people through shared experiences, not endless scrolling
• Join a local group (circle) to connect with like minded people
• Built for real-life connection, not performance

This is social wellness. 
Less noise. More meaning. Just good people doing real things.
The next generation of social media we're calling Rill Social.
